description: Find-your-federal-court lookup tables. Rows are arrays; see each file's `fields`.
notes: Coordinates are Census internal points rounded to 3 decimals (about 100 m); they locate a place, not an address.

places: district_id is the district containing the place's internal point; other_district_ids lists further districts whose counties the place reaches into (2020 place-by-county file; counties split by statute are left out of that list).
zcta: ZIP Code Tabulation Areas (Census 2020) approximate USPS ZIP codes; some ZIP codes (PO boxes, single buildings) have no ZCTA. Shares are of the ZCTA's land area.
American Samoa (5 county-equivalents, ZCTA 96799) belongs to no judicial district and is omitted.
